description: Plays one of ninety-six drum samples built into the module, with pitch, decay and level controls

params.text: Picks which set of samples is used: BD, SN, CL, OH, PERC or CLAP, named in the box below the knob
Picks which of the sixteen samples of that set is played, 1 to 16
Sets the playback speed as a power of two, -1 to 1, which is an octave down at the bottom and an octave up at the top
Sets how long the sound is held before it fades, from 4.5ms at the bottom to 4 seconds at the top
Attenuates the voltage at the Dec jack before it is added to the Dec knob, 0 to 1

inputs.text: Each trigger here starts the sample again from its beginning
Modulates the decay, a tenth per volt scaled by the Decay CV knob
Scales the level by cable, a tenth per volt multiplying the Gain knob rather than adding to it

outputs.text: The sample at the set pitch, shaped by the decay envelope

notes: the samples are built into the module, so nothing has to be loaded; the two knobs at the top are the whole of the sample choice
a sample is played at its own length, and the decay envelope only shortens it; a long decay does not make a short sample longer

inputs.0: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.1:
continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob; the knob and this input are summed and the total held to 0 to 1V.
inputs.2:
0 to 10V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads the Gain knob alone.
